name: Thunderous Cacophony
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 4, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round/2 levels (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the area with roaring thunderous crashes. Each creature beginning their turn in or entering the area takes 4d6 points of sonic damage and is deafened for 2 rounds. This deafening does not stack on consecutive rounds, but it extends the duration. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the deafening.

This cacophony has the added effect of disrupting other auditory effects. Any such language-dependent, auditory, or sonic effect only has a 50% chance of being effective against a creature in the area each round.
